ResearchTabDef.label: Strategic Missiles
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: Research ballistic missile systems able to strike the local map and targets across the world map.

ResearchProjectDef.label: tactical ballistic missiles
ResearchProjectDef.description: Short-range ballistic missiles with inertial and satellite guidance, fired from a crewed launcher. Unlocks the tactical missile launcher and its missiles, which can hit settlements on the world map.

ResearchProjectDef.label: intercontinental ballistic missiles
ResearchProjectDef.description: Multi-stage ballistic missiles launched from hardened silos, able to reach settlements anywhere within 500 world tiles. Unlocks the ICBM silo and conventional ICBMs. With Dubs Rimatomics, also nuclear ICBMs built around its fission warheads.

ResearchProjectDef.label: missile defense
ResearchProjectDef.description: Radar-guided hit-to-kill interceptors that destroy artillery shells and ballistic missiles in flight. Unlocks the missile defense battery and interceptor missiles.

ResearchProjectDef.label: towed howitzers
ResearchProjectDef.description: Lightweight 155 mm towed howitzers able to shell targets on the world map. Unlocks the M777 howitzer (uses Combat Extended 155 mm shells).

ResearchProjectDef.label: multiple rocket launchers
ResearchProjectDef.description: Launchers firing salvos of satellite-guided 227 mm rockets. Unlocks the multiple rocket launcher and its rockets.

ResearchProjectDef.label: cruise missiles
ResearchProjectDef.description: Subsonic, terrain-following land-attack missiles with very long reach and great precision. Unlocks the cruise missile launcher and cruise missiles.

ResearchProjectDef.label: special warheads
ResearchProjectDef.description: Cluster, thermobaric and EMP warheads for tactical ballistic missiles and ICBMs. EMP warheads are the weapon of choice against mechanoid hives.
